spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: No oirá a ustedes Faraón, a fin de multiplicar mis prodigios en tierra de Egipto.

findings.issue: Qal infinitive construct is intransitive (become many), and the plural noun is what becomes many. Transitive multiplicar makes the wonders the object and, by Spanish subject control from the finite clause, makes Faraón the agent.

notes: Wayyiqtol, Jehová, Moisés, Faraón, 2mp ustedes, plural suffix, and Egipto match the tokens.
